name: add_note
title: Add note
description: Add a child note (Markdown, converted to Zotero HTML) to an existing item. Two-step confirm: confirmed=false (default) returns a preview; confirmed=true writes the note.

id.description: Global ID of the parent item.

content.description: Note body in Markdown. Converted to Zotero note HTML.

confirmed.description: Must be true to perform the write. confirmed=false returns a preview.
